notes.title: Character Customization Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone. We've been working on a few features that will help steer the game towards our long-term goal. 
We're excited to announce the beginning of the integration with Steam's Inventory Service. Through gameplay you can obtain cosmetic items which will show in your Steam Inventory. These items can be traded or sold as well! Currently we have hats, shirts, pants and bullet trails available. We are also considering the possibility of including Workshop integration to allow players to create their own styles, but that's still a while away.
Furthermore, we have begun to develop skills, they are currently divided into two categories: quick skills, which are intended to be used to create an immediate impact and lasting skills, which should grant some benefit or effect over a longer period of time. You can pick one of each before every run and multiplayer session for now, but eventually this will be further tied into the game mechanics.
Both these features are accessible through a new option (Character) in the menu, where you can also set your character's physical features such as face, eyes, hair and more.
Soon we will also have some rewards for challenge winners and top placing players, and don't worry, previous challenge participants will be rewarded too!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Minor update
notes.content: Fix some minor bugs and add interpolation to character - player characters now move more smoothly!

notes.title: Minor update
notes.content:
- Added "Showdown" UI to challenge bosses you have faced before, new random bosses or even a boss of any name you wish
- Reduced "challenge" card in main screen (now only "Most Wanted" is visible)
- Added "challenge" card at the end screen of challenge mode

notes.title: Minor update
notes.content:
Bugfix: gatling's gun was jammed! Not anymore, be careful ;)

Also would like to anticipate that we're working on improving boss AI and adding personality traits so that they will behave slightly differently one from another.

notes.title: Update (v 0.12.7)
notes.content:
- Added "reloading" mechanic. Players now have 6 bullets per round, after which the character will automatically reload. At any time, however, players may reload (R on keyboard, RB/R1 on controllers). Enemies also have limited bullets per round, this will be most noticeable on the behavior of Bandits. This rule also applies to multiplayer mode.
- Fixed issue with controllers not aiming.
- Added controller icons to tutorial screens.
- Added "controls" screen to "Settings" menu. Currently still not able to change the keymapping though, this is still in progress.

notes.title: More multiplayer fixes
notes.content:
Players can now stomp and use skills in multiplayer. Currently "bullet time" is disabled, have to figure out how (if ever) it will work in multiplayer... Furthermore bullets now should be more accurate between different players, reducing "false positive" kills.

Added skill icons to player status bar, shows if the skill is ready, still working on visuals (we know, tooltip is way too small to understand which button you should press.) FYI: "left shift" activates "long skill" (currently only Bullet Time) and "Q" or "right mouse button" activates "quick skill" (currently only Deflection Blast).

Also we noticed that controllers aren't working anymore, we're working on getting that fixed.

notes.title: Multiplayer fix
notes.content: Fixed some stability issues in multiplayer. Session setup should be slightly faster and less buggy. Player management also has been rewritten in order to eliminate some bugs.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content: Fixed game not restarting correctly after dying and player information HUD not properly displaying player's data.

notes.title: Bossy Boys
notes.content:
So you thought things were settling down? There's a new boss in the house. In single-player mode you now must fight a fierce foe and claim your stakes against the bandit boss.

[u]Change List:[/u]
[list]
[*] New player status UI.
[*] Updated enemy AI - they now attempt to avoid bullets and players.
[*] Added a world environment.
[*] New single-player boss-fight level.
[*] Added localization, currently english & portuguese brazil -- olá amigos! :)
[*] Bandit cooldown fixed.
[*] Added badge item (basically a 2nd hp).
[*] Player now bounces when stomping.
[*] Gunslinger can now be stunned by slam.
[*] Gunslinger is now vulnerable when stunned.
[*] Fixed slam stun area.
[*] Several bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Sidekicks!!
notes.content:
I had a dream I was a vigilant sidekick... And now you can be one too. Join a buddy and help him fight crime in the streets together. We have implemented the first iteration of local co-op with the intention of also allowing players to play through Remote Play Together!

You (or your friend if using Remote Play Together) must have a controller. One player can play on the keyboard while the other plays on the controller. Pressing F2 will make "P2" use keyboard, likewise pressing "select" (PS) or "back" (Xbox) button on the controller should tell the game P2 will be using that controller.

[u]Change List[/u]
[list]
[*] Added local co-op for "single player" mode.
[*] Added projection shadow to help show where player will land.
[*] Bandit now looks where he's going.
[*] Added further graphic options to enable/disable post-processing effects.
[*] New main menu UI.
[*] All new animated intro sequence.
[*] Effects are now pooled in order to reduce instancing performance issue.
[/list]

notes.title: Little things
notes.content:
Howdy, partners!

In this minor update we bring a new settings screen which is categorized. Also we have temporarily included toggles to allow disabling rendering effects to better gauge potential performance killers on the fly.

[u]Change List[/u]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced game speed on normal difficulty, and further on easier difficulties.
[*] Slightly increased default camera distance.
[*] Added jumping and landing effects for enemies too.
[*] Added streching & squishing for player jumping and landing animations.
[*] Added base camera height offset so player can always see the floor from slightly above.
[*] Reworked the entire input system to better handle local multiplayer (coming soon).
[*] Fixed enemies respawning in Challenge mode.
[*] Fixed incorrect Z distance of some platforms.
[*] Fixed inconsistent footsteps.
[*] Fixed ricochet decal orientation.
[*] Fixed some naughty background rocks fighting for Z preference.
[/list]

notes.title: Particularly Purty
notes.content:
Howdy, partners!

In this peculiar update we have proposed new props and particularly overhauled the particle effects. We reckon things should look a tad more shinier. We are preparing to allow players to equip custom effects for different in-game actions too. So prepare to look particularly purty!

[u]Change List[/u]
[list]
[*] Added new skill: slam. When falling very fast you can hold your down button to slam into the ground and cause stun to nearby enemies.
[*] New death effect.
[*] Added new ricochets.
[*] New bullet animation and sound.
[*] Added footsteps. You can run, but you cannot hide!
[*] Added several new level elements, between props and surfaces.
[*] Improved text effects.
[*] Improved candles' visuals.
[*] Added difficulty selector. Certain rules are changed to make the game easier or harder. Pick your poison, partner!
[*] Bullets can go astray. Depending on certain conditions they will leave the world and break your screen. Beware!
[*] Entities spawn in a waiting state until player takes first action. Mighty graceful of 'em I'll say.
[*] Give up button doesn't trigger death animation anymore. Straight back to main menu, ain't nobody got time fo' dat!
[*] Cacti now sway a bit with the wind.
[*] Heart breaking animation is back, for all those of romantic inclination.
[*] Added wanted sign prop with player's character face.
[*] Most sound effects now have slight variation of pitch to reduce repetitiveness.
[*] Fixed wide platform crossing walls.
[*] Slightly tweaked bandit behavior.
[*] Gunslinger will now visually move to the back of the room when in hiding.
[/list]

notes.title: Update - v0.10.0
notes.content:
Many small polishments have been made in this update, mostly cosmetic.

[u]Change List[/u]
[list]
[*] Added "stomp" to tutorial.
[*] Removed "Friendly Fire" and "Respawn Enemies" options from Settings.
[*] Improved bullet trail shader.
[*] Props now can be placed at different depths to create a better environment.
[*] Tweaked the visuals of day and night levels.
[*] Camera now clamps to floor at night-level as well.
[*] Improved character collision logic in regards to walls.
[*] Slightly increased size of trapdoors.
[*] Slightly adjusted colliders on rock platforms.
[*] Fixed bogus spawn points in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed some small gaps in floor that ate bullets.
[*] Fixed placement of some objects
[/list]

notes.title: Update - v0.9.6
notes.content:
This update brings some gameplay changes. Now you can kill enemies by stomping on their heads, just like those brothers with moustaches. Also, now friendly fire is not deadly, but it is stunning... literally. A tutorial level has been created. We know you guys are all pros by now, but since there was no tutorial previously, the system has flagged everyone as a newbie. Go beat that tutorial like a boss. Since we are now going to be in Early Access, an icon has been added to the UI to make it clear that the game is in Early Access state.


[u]Change List[/u]
[list]
[*] Players can now stomp enemies.
[*] Friendly fire now causes Stun.
[*] Added tutorial level.
[*] Added Early Access icon to UI.
[*] Fixed placement of some elements that made it hard to access a specific trap door.
[*] Removed the floating skull that showed up occasionally.
[/list]

notes.title: Update - v0.9.0 alpha
notes.content:
Now Bullets Are Fatal! will host weekend showdowns. You have 3 chances on Saturday, then, on Sunday, for every succeeded chance you get to continue your run to become #1



[u]Change List[/u]
[list]
[*] Added Showdowns.
[*] New home screen UI.
[*] New achievement.
[/list]

notes.title: Update - v0.8.17 alpha
notes.content:
Added Challenges. Play a specific level with specific rules to earn a place on the leaderboard. Challenges change every sunday!



[u]Change List[/u]
[list]
[*] Added Challenges.
[*] Save character appearance to Steam Cloud.
[*] [i]Bug Fix[/i]: Achievements could trigger in-game even if the player had already earned them in a previous gaming session.
[*] [i]Bug Fix[/i]: Character Editor UI had some fields misbehaving depending on resolution.
[*] [i]Bug Fix[/i]: Bandits had bad pivot and this caused them to occasionally cross walls.
[*] [i]Bug Fix[/i]: All enemies killed were counted as Bandits.
[*] [i]Bug Fix[/i]: Sometimes too many points were awarded for passing the 1st level.
